notes.title: August Update Note (+Abuse Policy Update)
notes.notes:
Mercenaries! 

The August Update has arrived!

This update celebrates the 3rd Anniversary of A.V.A Global with exciting new content, challenges, and powerful gear. Get ready to dive into explosive missions, fresh maps, and exclusive anniversary rewards!


New Demolition Map : NAMSAN
The new demolition map Namsan is set around Seoul’s iconic landmark, Namsan, and is inspired by traditional Korean hanok architecture. It features complex terrain with significant elevation differences and strategically hidden points throughout the urban environment.



The map is designed to support fast-paced combat and dynamic tactical play, with structures that facilitate both attacking and defending. Key strategic elements, such as doors that automatically open when a C4 is planted and rooftops of convenience stores, are positioned to have a decisive impact on the flow of battle.



Players can expect multiple attack and defense routes, allowing for simultaneous breakthroughs, flanking maneuvers, and versatile tactical strategies. Elevation differences and urban obstacles encourage players to think creatively and make strategic use of the environment.



Experience Namsan, the first map to bring a Korean cityscape into A.V.A, and explore the fast-paced, tactical gameplay it offers!

Abuse Policy Update - Custom Channel XP
We have identified cases where players created abnormal rooms in Custom Channels to gain experience points unfairly. After reviewing previous season data, it appears some XP was obtained through unintended methods.

To ensure fair play, a new rule will be applied starting this season:

Any player caught abusing XP gain in this manner will have their Season Ranking reset by default.

The definition of “abnormal behavior” is at the discretion of the game operations team.

Penalty Structure:
[olist]
1st – Warning

2nd – 30-day account suspension

3rd – Permanent ban
[/olist]
We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in maintaining a fair and competitive environment.



Sincerely,

Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: July Update Note
notes.notes:
Mercenaries!

The July Update Is Here!

Get ready for new content and exciting changes!


New Annihilation Map : Anaconda Core
\[What is Core Map?]

Core Map Content offers a fresh take on the strategic and tactical hotspots within existing maps. It reinterprets and reintroduces areas where key engagements typically unfold.

For this iteration, Anaconda: Core, we've modified three crucial combat zones from the original map layout.

Firstly, we've opened up the entrances to the central engagement area, which previously acted as a bridge, allowing for horizontal flanking maneuvers into enemy territory. This changes the combat flow from primarily vertical engagements to now include broader horizontal pushes.

Furthermore, we've reconfigured the pathways into each faction's territory, making them accessible to all teams. This adjustment encourages more dynamic back-line infiltration and allows for the proactive use of defensive positions.

By altering these core structural elements, we aim to deliver more thrilling gameplay, enabling players to secure victory through a wider array of strategies and tactics.

We appreciate your keen interest and participation!

notes.title: Share Your Feedback on the April Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/69b7e9d38ea52178bb099c44a862b8a8b1b9fc61.png
Mercenaries!

As part of the April update, we’ve introduced several exciting changes to enhance your gameplay experience. These include updates to season rewards, the addition of the ultimate weapon, crosshair customization, weapon balance update, adjustments to Quick Match modes, and the introduction of the new mode - AirBorne. We’re eager to hear how these changes have impacted your time in the game!

Our development team continues to prioritize fixing in-game crash issues, and we are working diligently to identify and resolve their underlying causes. At the same time, your feedback is invaluable in guiding our efforts to improve future updates and refine the overall AVA experience.

Please take a moment to share your thoughts on the April update by completing our survey. Your feedback directly influences how we continue to evolve AVA Global.

[April Update Survey]

 Survey Link: https://forms.gle/Q1pPCby9VM9kdmVK9
 Alternative Link (for users in China): https://forms.office.com/r/nk111UatfG
 Survey Period: May 9 – May 18 (UTC)


============================================================
March Update Feedback Recap


Through the March Update survey, we’ve gathered the following key feedback and are sharing our direction with you:

[Weapon Balance]
Recent adjustments to weapon balance, as well as the new base weapon 'Gilboa', have received overall positive responses.
For Gilboa, players have evaluated it as having appropriate performance, rather than being overpowered, and many expressed hope for more well-adjusted weapons to be added in the future.

On the other hand, there are still ongoing concerns about the excessive performance of certain weapons such as the TC-9 and Raven Pro.
We are monitoring these balance issues closely and will be conducting a separate survey to gather more specific feedback on these weapons.

[New Maps]
The new maps 'Jinguashi' and 'Blind Eagle' have generally received high satisfaction.
'Blind Eagle' has been praised for its strategic gameplay, while there were mixed opinions about the map size of 'Jinguashi'.
Based on this feedback, we will continue focusing on designing maps that accommodate various playstyles.

[Quick Match Mode Feedback]
We’ve received various requests for improvements related to Quick Match rotation, mode configuration, and team balance.
In particular, we are aware of the issues with matchmaking difficulties in the EU region and the desire for players to freely play all maps, and we are considering ways to address these concerns.

For new maps and modes, we are balancing the introduction between Quick Match and Custom Channels.
In the future, new modes will be introduced to Quick Match first and gradually made available in Custom Channels after a period.
Through this approach, we aim to expand the environment where players can enjoy a variety of content freely.

[EXP & Level-Up Rewards]
Adjustments to AI experience points and kill targets have received positive feedback, but there were some concerns about level-up rewards.
Based on this feedback, we revamped the level-up reward system in the April update.
We will continue to review and monitor player feedback on these changes.

[Other Suggestions]
The frequently mentioned memory crash issues are currently being prioritized by the development team.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by unexpected game closures or malfunctions.
We are thoroughly analyzing the cause of the issue and will do our best to resolve it quickly, ensuring a stable environment for players.

Additionally, we’ve received feedback on the skin combination system, rewards for players over level 200, and other areas.
We will continue to update the reward components on a monthly basis to ensure players above level 200 can still enjoy a steady flow of AVA Coins and engaging rewards.
============================================================

Your insights are crucial in helping AVA Global reach new heights. Thank you for being an essential part of the community!

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: February Update Survey Results & Developer Feedback
notes.notes:
Mercenaries,

Thank you for participating in the February update survey.
We have carefully reviewed every piece of feedback you provided.

The survey focused on five key areas, and we'd like to share the results and our development plans with everyone, including those who may not have participated but continue to enjoy playing AVA.

1&2) Weapon Rebalancing & Weapons Needing Adjustment

[Survey Results]
 While some players were satisfied with the current state, many were not.
 The most commonly raised issue was the polarization of weapon performance, especially concerns over the balance of older weapons.

[Developer Comments & Future Plans]

 Thank you for helping us review a wide range of feedback through this survey.
 Weapon balance will continue to be adjusted through upcoming updates, and we appreciate your continued interest and support.
 In future updates, we will prioritize ARs and SMGs and apply more careful and deliberate adjustments.
 While internal balance direction is important, we believe the most important goal is to ensure weapons are fun to play with.
We will prepare updates that will allow you to enjoy using more weapons through major balancing patches.
3) New Maps & Quick Match Mode Changes

[Survey Results]
 Reactions to the new maps were mixed, but many found them refreshing.
 However, many players expressed disappointment with the Quick Match mode changes, particularly hoping for the return of popular legacy modes.
 We also received feedback asking for a wider variety of maps to be available in Custom Channels.

[Developer Comments & Future Plans]

 In the case of Quick Match, we have continued to introduce various updates over time, but we've recognized that overall player satisfaction has not been high.
To refocus on AVA’s core battlefield experience, we plan to narrow our focus to a few key modes.
 However, since AVA offers a wide variety of modes, rather than fully reworking them, we are considering bringing back some as time-limited event modes.

4) Reward System Adjustments

[Survey Results]
 Some players appreciated the updates to attendance, daily, and season rewards.
 However, many felt the value and impact of rewards were insufficient.
 In particular, there were repeated comments about season rewards, capsule probabilities, and the quantity of AVA Coins

[Developer Comments & Future Plans]
 The development team shares your concerns regarding the reward system and will continue to review and apply improvements.

5) Season Level System

[Survey Results]
 Some players enjoyed the fast level progression, but many noted that rewards became less motivating after reaching level 200.
 There was also feedback from players who prefer the traditional rank system.

[Developer Comments & Future Plans]
 We aim to improve the season level system to make it more fun and continuously motivating.
 For example, we plan to offer honor-based rewards and enjoyable seasonal content, and seasonal items will be arranged differently from previous formats to keep things fresh.
 To address the drop in AVA Coin earnings after level 200, we are preparing quests and events to maintain consistent rewards.
 The original rank system will remain as the account-level rank, and we will continue to provide seasonal content and events that align with the seasonal progression system.
We hope you look forward to what's coming!

All the feedback collected from this survey has been shared internally and will be actively referenced when planning future updates.

Thank you once again for your continued support of A.V.A Global.
We’ll keep working hard to deliver a better gameplay experience.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: [Update Preview] Dec. New Map Open!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0a0e8e9bbe1eed18ade2ae70fee4aa050519641a.png

Mercenaries!

In this December update, we are preparing multiple maps update!
You will experience various battlefields!

1.Escape - Last Break
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/691b28a73f2ef703f7cd83ea44756a4c511b9383.png

A new escape mode map, "The Last Break," has been added with the December update!

Unlike the other escape maps, combat in this map is simpler, but the engagement distances have been slightly extended. This feature offers players more strategic options.

With five alarm points, it might be challenging for the NRF team to defend. However, we have carefully designed the NRF base to ensure that they can effectively manage their defense.

Additionally, the map features an underground passage and three escape routes. Instead of crowding in one area, NRF players can establish defensive positions in the escape zones or at the entrances of each escape route to prevent the EU team from escaping easily.

Map Concept
The concept for this map is inspired by a neighboring area of one of AVA's iconic maps, "Fox Hunting." The EU base in Fox Hunting serves as the escape point in The Last Break, providing a thematic connection between the two maps.

2.Reaper flow
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/4fb515ee70aa9f1cbdd03ed20dfa5c9fb76fb631.png

Knife Battle Elimination Mode: During gameplay, you may notice players becoming the Hero.

When a player becomes the Hero, they can use a special weapon called the "Dragon Crescent Blade" for 30 seconds.

If the 30 seconds expire or they are killed by another player, the Hero status will transfer to their killer or the next eligible player.

While the Hero has the advantage of using the powerful "Dragon Crescent Blade," their character's silhouette will be visible to all players, so careful strategy is essential!

We sincerely thank all players who continue to support AVA Global!

To give everyone a refreshing change of pace when taking a break from shooting, we’ve created this lighthearted knife battle map.

Though it may have some shortcomings, we hope you enjoy it and share your valuable feedback. We will actively reflect your input to make continuous improvements.

See you on the battlefield!

*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Team

notes.title: Dev Letter: Future Update Direction
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5a270ffc2e5caf159d1fc1d8e6b43f6d456a8362.png

Dear Mercenaries,

Hello, this is PD of AVA Global.

We would like to express our gratitude to all our users and apologize for any inconvenience caused by the late announcement. Through this communication, we aim to clearly outline the path we envision for AVA Global.


Our goal with AVA Global was to adapt to the global environment and prevent weapon performance from becoming pay-to-win (PTW). We aimed to offer all weapons through free currency (Euros&Titanium) to maintain balanced performance and create an environment where players could enjoy a variety of items.


However, user demand for performance exceeded our expectations, and items such as skins did not convey the intended value to players. As a result, while several weapons were released, they became a source of frustration rather than enjoyment, highlighting areas that need improvement.

Therefore, beginning with the December update, we plan to shift to a more hardcore weapon balance and introduce a new direction centered on this adjustment.


Pursuit of Hardcore Appeal
We are planning to adjust all firearms to a more hardcore style. After establishing a base balance suited for combat, we will gradually release weapons with unique performance characteristics.

Introduction of a New Season System
Through system upgrades, we plan to retain AVA’s classic appeal while introducing a new seasonal ranking system. Our goal is to motivate users with continuous leveling and rewards.

Restoring the Value of Skins and Items
We plan to improve the skin system to offer performance upgrades that meet user expectations. Additionally, we aim to introduce features such as a Black Market to facilitate user-to-user trading and market activity.

Reward System Improvement
We are reviewing ways to provide meaningful rewards through a restructured reward system. Players will be able to earn various items through Arena Challenges.

AVA Global aims to provide a gaming experience that both embraces the memories of the past and continues to evolve.

We sincerely appreciate your continued interest and support.
*We hope you can share your thoughts regarding the A.V.A Global Future Updates!
*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.

Sincerely,
AVA Global PD

notes.title: Dev Letter: Weapon Balance Update Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e2150a3f547ec0c1eaabcea1fb117e295eec1a0a.png

Dear Mercenaries,

At AVA Global, we are conducting a phased update to expand the core shooting experience unique to AVA Global. Based on user survey results, we are moving forward with a weapon balance update for Phase 3.

Weapon Balance Improvement Phase 3! Return of the Popular Mainstream Weapons!

Following the recent survey, we have once again realized that the weapons preferred by users are classic weapons such as the MA-47 and Cannon. Therefore, we are planning a balance adjustment focused on classic firearms, actively reflecting your opinions. Additionally, we are analyzing factors such as weapon usage rates and win rates to address weapon imbalance issues.

List of Balance Update Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/561cc6700e57025238f5b4d1949f0d973d457a76.png

We will continue to monitor the utilization and performance of user weapons, and we will closely observe less frequently used weapons considering the current balance. Our goal is to ensure that each weapon in AVA Global has its own unique identity and functionality. We are committed to careful review and ongoing balance updates. Although this process may take some time, we deeply appreciate your patience and understanding as we strive for optimal results.

With the news of the balance update, we have also prepared a bonus announcement. This is a great opportunity to obtain popular skins for 11 types of weapons scheduled for balance adjustments! We appreciate your keen interest. 
Announcement Link: (Link)

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Team

notes.title: April Skin Combination Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5ac0ee58365d617e0a9303de9e03dd372a2a4444.png

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are "Regular," "Epic,", "Premium", and "Unique".

After the April Update, the new skin combination rule will be available in the Pointman&Rifleman&Sniper Skins Combination System.

We prepared a new rule for Pointman&Rifleman&Sniper skins to make users use the specific existing premium tier skin to obtain a new Unique tier skin.

Pointman Skin Combination Rule:

[Regular + Regular]
a. Epic: Bahamut Bushman
b. Regular Skins

[Epic + Epic]
a. Premium : 870 Red Skull
b. Epic: Epic Skins
- 870 Red Skull: 25%
- Epic Skins: 75%

[Premium + Premium]
a. Unique Skins: 25%
b. Premium Skins: 75%

[Unique + Premium]
a. Unique Skins: 50%
b. Premium Skins: 50%

[Unique + Unique]
a. Unique Skins: 100%
*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.

Rifleman Skin Combination Rule:

[Regular + Regular]
a. Epic: X36 Gila
b. Regular Skins

a. Unique Skins: 50%

[Unique + Unique]

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.

Sniper Skin Combination Rule:

Note:

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/eabeaf775c6747f92d71f309574ff90e20127740.jpg

Mercenaries,

AVA Global has implemented a custom channel update in February, dedicated to fostering an environment where you can fully immerse yourself in the allure of AVA Global. 
Moving forward, our focus has shifted towards enriching the unparalleled shooting experience within the game rather than altering the environment.

Today, we're excited to share our upcoming plans and insights with you.

We're gearing up for a significant operation concerning firearms, a pivotal aspect of the game. 
Our strategy involves executing a three-stage base weapon balance operation. 
With the imminent update, we'll promptly roll out the first stage to elevate the core excitement and gameplay of AVA Global.


 Stage 1 New Balance: Starting with an update of 50 or more weapons, followed by continuous updates with the addition of new weapons.
 Stage 2 Re-Balancing: Creating a new weapon ecosystem with enhanced gameplay through the repositioning of all weapons.
 Stage 3 Post-Balance: Strengthening balance management based on various user experiences in the newly changed environment.


Stage 1: New Balance 
- Diversified Firearms:
AVA Global is set to expand the arsenal of firearms available in-game, ensuring a more comprehensive reflection of your unique strategies and play styles. 
Expect over 50 new base weapons to be introduced, offering players a diverse selection to tailor their loadouts to their individual roles. 
Through in-game stores and events, we'll diversify acquisition avenues and adjust Euro sale prices to make new weapons more accessible, enriching your experience with strategic depth and gameplay enjoyment unique to AVA Global.

Stage 2: Re-Balancing 
- Strategic Weapon Repositioning:
Following the comprehensive update of 50 base weapons, the subsequent phase will focus on strategically repositioning the new additions.
Our goal with re-balancing is to foster a more competitive and varied gameplay experience, empowering players to choose and personalize their weapons. 
We're confident this process will positively impact your gameplay.

Stage 3: Post-Balance 
- Continuous Ecosystem Management:
After completing the initial two stages, we'll embark on ongoing balance management to further enhance the core excitement of AVA Global. 
Post-update, we'll meticulously analyze in-game data and fine-tune balance based on diverse user experiences, maximizing the unique shooting experience of AVA Global in the dynamically evolving environment.

This update signifies a significant stride in the growth and development of AVA Global. 
Our aim is to not only expand the core fun of the game but also ignite excitement among our players.

Your continued interest, participation, and invaluable feedback are vital in propelling AVA Global forward. 
We remain committed to fostering enhanced communication and delivering an unparalleled gaming experience.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
A.V.A Global Team

notes.title: February Update Preview
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1a998f874ae028898a9cc359d6827bb4c67bfe80.jpg

Mercenaries!

In this February update, we will add a variety of content centered around the long-awaited custom channels.

The development of custom channels is already in its final stage, and new content that will enrich the custom channels further is scheduled to be updated sequentially.

Over the past few months, A.V.A Global has conducted a massive update and has incorporated various feedback from you, including the custom channels, new season HEX, and new maps, among other elements, to be added in this update.

February Update Preview:
1. Custom Rooms
We are very excited to share interesting development news about custom rooms, which many of you have been waiting for. We are preparing to meet your expectations and sincerely thank you for your patience.

The custom rooms, currently in the final stage of preparation, aim to provide a space carefully designed for an enhanced personalized experience.

With this February update, modes like Demolition, Annihilation, Sniper Annihilation, AI Mode, Breakthrough, and Escape are scheduled for early update, with PVE modes to follow sequentially.

Our goal is to create a dynamic and specialized environment reflecting the features you desire. Beyond this, by introducing customized rooms, we are opening new possibilities for the community.

We are thrilled about the upcoming release of user-customized channels, paving the way for tournaments and events led by Game Masters (GMs).

This additional feature is designed to introduce competition and community aspects to the platform, enabling personalized experiences and providing an environment for thrilling competitions and events.

Please stay tuned for an updated guide related to custom rooms before the update.

2. New Season: HEX(100% Medal Pay-Back!)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3c96f9f0766d5d7e94cce0d618cf03a622a656b4.jpg

For A.V.A Global, the Battle Pass is one of the key contents that offers users limited season skins, in-game currency, and various rewards. Based on your feedback, we have extended the Battle Pass level range and introduced a tutorial level-up system among other initiatives.

As this has been a highly anticipated update, we have received various feedback from users. Accordingly, as many have mentioned, the HEX season is scheduled to be reflected in this massive update.

To show our appreciation for your support and interest, this season will feature a special "100% MEDAL PAY-BACK" activity (Exclusive).

This Battle Pass section will allow all users to obtain all modifiable HEX series primary weapons, ensuring a diverse collection of limited skins.

3. New Maps
With this update, a variety of new maps, led by Windmill, will be coming your way.

Windmill is set to launch as a new Sniper Annihilation mode, eagerly awaited by many users, and will include additional new maps linked with custom rooms, providing a fresh and fun experience unlike anything seen in A.V.A Global before.

In Conclusion
Since the January update, A.V.A Global has been preparing updates aimed at enhancing the unique fun of A.V.A Global gameplay.

Besides the content mentioned earlier, a skin combination system and a new skin series are also scheduled for this update, so we ask for your keen interest.

As always, we are continuously researching new ways to enhance the A.V.A Global gaming experience and are always listening to your valuable feedback on upcoming new systems and content.

Please look forward to more detailed information about our new development work through patch notes and announcements in future updates.

notes.title: Ops Team honest talk: AVA Global Update Direction
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/395e7e14abd35a60c7050d32118a8c0f38662c7c.jpg

Mercenaries,

We appreciate the tremendous support and encouragement for the progress we shared on January 17th.
Through this opportunity, we want to share with you the content we have been preparing for the upcoming updates starting from January.

Thank you for the support and encouragement you've shown for the information we provided on January 17th.

Feeling that we may have kept you waiting for too long,
we want to quickly share with you the content we have been preparing for the mid to long term, starting from the January update.
(Please note that the following plans may be subject to change depending on the situation.)

AVA Global Update Direction:
STEP 1: Adding the PVE mode you asked for, reinforcing game MODE feedback
- New PVE mode:
Since the launch of AVA Global, users have been requesting the release of various PVE modes.
In response to this feedback, we have introduced a variety of modes such as AVA Train, Death Valley, and Overrider.
While many users have enjoyed these modes, we have received numerous requests for improvements to these mode updates.
We are currently working on preparations to introduce a new PVE mode as quickly as possible,
and we hope to share the news of the mode update with you through the January update.
(Hint: P.B.)

Reinforcement of Weapon MOD System feedback:
Alongside this, there will be a revision to the Weapon MOD system.
As there have been opinions that the current effects are unclear, the system will be revised to provide clear feedback.
Additionally, to help users find their preferred firearm style with various specs,
we are planning to distribute Weapon MOD Tickets abundantly.

Furthermore, recognizing that the firearm Weapon MOD system is not limited to new skins, and in consideration of the value preservation of existing skins,
each branch will add one existing weapon to its list in the January update.

We are aware that the modification system can have a significant impact on firearm balance, so we are approaching it with caution,
and detailed information will be provided in the upcoming January update announcement!

STEP 2: Sharing the development status of Custom Rooms.
We are preparing the creation of custom rooms, which received the highest percentage of feedback from you.
In order to provide a more stable environment, we are currently accelerating development with the goal of reflecting it in the February 2024 update.

We are excited as the day approaches when we can finally introduce custom rooms to you.
We will do our best to ensure you can enjoy custom rooms stably.

STEP 3: Weapon rebalancing

In A.V.A Global, 'Unique weapon recoil pattern' is a key element that allows you to experience the unique fun of AVA Global.
Among the feedback, the most mentioned aspects were (1) firearm balance and (2) various base firearms.

Therefore, we are contemplating a comprehensive overhaul to balance existing versions and maximize the fun at the current stage.
We plan to revamp it in a direction where you can utilize a variety of weapons according to your play style in the mid to long term.

In the process of setting this direction, we will continuously share intermediate situations with you.
We will carefully consider and proceed with the rebalancing based on your valuable feedback.

In addition, we are preparing to introduce even more diverse new content,
and we will continue to communicate with you and build together in the future.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: December Update Developer Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c337b8f3f1bcc7e18569e0b99b7b5d517c334e0e.png
Mercenaries!

One of the most important aspects at A.V.A Global is the shooting play. Utilizing various weapons in-game to navigate the battlefield and progressing through gameplay with suitable strategies for each battlefield is a crucial element at A.V.A Global. Over the next few months, A.V.A Global is planning extensive updates to provide you with a more enjoyable gaming environment. Today, we will share updates regarding these plans and upcoming patches.

December Update Preview:

Battle Pass Renewal:
The Battle Pass at A.V.A Global is a major content where many users can obtain diverse rewards such as limited-season skins and in-game currency. Based on user feedback, we have attempted various changes, including extending Battle Pass level ranges and introducing a tutorial level-up system.

However, many users mentioned that the Battle Pass cycle is too long. Therefore, starting from this December, the Battle Pass duration will decrease to match each update period. Although the duration is shorter than the previous three months, the overall rewards will include seasonal limited skins at the same level as three update rewards. In the December Battle Pass, you can experience various "Christmas" themed skins, and it will be designed to offer a more diverse range of skins for all users during the December update. Additionally, a larger-scale change is planned for January next year, so we appreciate your participation.

New Game Maps&Modes:
With this map update, White Out and Break Out maps will be introduced, and White Out, a new Breach mode that many users have been anticipating, will be released.

Furthermore, the newly added Break Out mode, Steal and Escape, will be a completely new and entertaining mode that you haven't experienced in A.V.A Global.
 
Daily Match System:
Additionally, the December update will introduce the Daily Match system. Unlike Arena Match, Daily Match will offer a fast pace fun for users. While Arena is a "Hardcore" system where skilled players compete for the highest skill and top-tier rewards, Daily Match will provide a relatively lighter but compact match system. Players can earn much more rewards in a short playtime compared to the existing Quick Match rewards.

As this is the first time for this content, the December update will be conducted in a "Free Season" format. We plan to continuously improve based on your feedback.

Also, new items will be added to the "Ultimate Unique Soldier Box," which was tentatively distributed in the previous Arena. So, we ask for your interest in both Daily Match and Arena Season.

Special Shop:
We have presented attractive skins through various capsules and boxes, and many users have provided feedback on capsule shops and in-game shops. Based on your feedback, a Special Shop with high accessibility and easy participation will be added. Through this new shop, you can obtain a more diverse range of items. Please check for details in future announcements.
 

Goals for the January 2024 Update:
While December is focused on new attempts, January 2024 is preparing for an update in the direction of providing a unique enjoyment of A.V.A Global gameplay. Although detailed information will be revealed in the future as development is ongoing, the next update is planned to prepare A.V.A Global users to feel the core fun of A.V.A more clearly.

To achieve this, we are developing the Custom Channel and Black Market as development goals for the first quarter of 2024. A large-scale update is planned to enhance the core fun of A.V.A Global, so we ask for your interest not only in the December update but also in the content to be added in January 2024.

In conclusion...

Our ultimate goal in the development plan is to provide a better playing environment that aligns with how players enjoy the game today. As always, we will continuously research new ways to enhance the A.V.A Global gaming experience, and we always value your valuable feedback on upcoming new systems and content.

Please stay tuned for more detailed information on the new development work we have prepared through patch notes and announcements in future updates.

Thank you.
A.V.A Global Operations Team

notes.title: DEV LETTER: November Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d334bdf024405f753a633967a964b52cc61bfcce.png

Mercenaries!

As you may already know, since its launch, AVA Global has introduced various weapons and skins, a variety of PVE modes through constant updates, and new content based on what you've been telling us!

We still can't get over the day we launched AVA Global and gave our users their first taste of the game, and it's still a fantastic memory for us. That's why we've always listened to your comments and feedback, and we're always thinking about how we can make your gaming experience with AVA Global even more enjoyable.

AI Mode Launch

With the November update, we're introducing a new mode, AI Demolition Mode, which will be available in Quick Match. AI Demolition Mode has been a highly anticipated mode for many of our users, and we're thrilled to finally bring it to you after a lot of development and adaptation to the AVA Global environment.

This AI Demolition Mode is all about the shooter aspect of the game, so it will be a lot of fun to utilize the shooting and weaponry unique to AVA Global. 

Stay tuned for more details on this new mode!

Improved Gun Content

As everyone knows, the core content of AVA Global is gunplay & skins, and we believe that gunplay with various maps is one of the most essential parts of the AVA Global gaming experience.

That's why we've been thinking about how we can make your gaming experience with AVA Global more enjoyable.

With this update, we're introducing a new system, the Gun Modification System, which will allow you to create and play with your own guns. Of course, the Gun Modification System isn't just a gun enhancement system, it will allow you to customize your guns to suit your own playstyle. In addition, Gun Modification System-enabled guns will also be available to free-to-play users, and we will continue to improve the system through future updates.

New Balance Improvements

We wanted every item to be an "attractive item" in-game, and we worked hard to create a game environment where users could choose from all the items and have a variety of fun.

In addition to this, we are constantly evolving the game to create a game environment where more diverse items (characters & weapons) perform better and to diversify further the routes users can take to enjoy the fun of shooting.

This requires a careful approach to ensure that the core gameplay fun of AVA Global is maintained without compromising the game experience for all AVA Global users, and we've taken into account the various balance suggestions you've provided through various channels, such as the gun modification system. Plus, character HP balance rollbacks will be patched.

Of course, this isn't the end of our balancing work, as we'll continue to listen to you and actively incorporate your feedback into future updates and development.

We believe this proactive approach to communicating with you will only make AVA Global a more fun game to play. 

Last but not least, we will continue to make updates in various areas, such as item balancing and adding new modes, and we will do our best to ensure a fair and stable in-game environment. Although these tasks will not be solved with just a few patches, we will not give up.

We want everyone to have fun in AVA Global, and we hope you'll stay tuned for future growth and updates.

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.


Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global Dev Letter: August Balance Patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/294ba589586bbf47bd884734a6df091974a7d1bb.png

Mercenaries!

First and foremost, we extend our sincere gratitude to you for showing continued support for AVA Global!

We have been diligently analyzing gameplay data to ensure that you have a more enjoyable and immersive experience. Through our analysis, we have identified the need to improve the character and weapon balance.

Considering that these updates are in their early stages, we understand that some players might encounter instances of confusion, awkwardness, or temporary inconvenience.

However, we believe that these changes are necessary to create a more fair and competitive environment for all players. We will continue to monitor the data and make further adjustments as needed.

Our goal is to implement positive changes that will improve the game for everyone. We are committed to making AVA Global the best it can be, and we appreciate your feedback as we move forward.

A.V.A Global development team is constantly brainstorming new ways to improve the game, drawing on the years of experience that players have accumulated.

We've pondered the significance of introducing updates that consistently reshape weapon performance. This introspection led us to seek avenues for elevating the gaming experience to new heights. Today, we're proud to share that after thorough reflection, we've pinpointed a pivotal juncture for change.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3605107b14f4b9d0973685296d04a0d9b6634d18.png

Our reflections have centered around augmenting the allure of characters, aiming ultimately to establish a captivating synergy between characters and weapons.

In AVA Global, character roles are currently not as strategically significant as we would like. To address this, we are rebalancing the game's structure to better utilize the strategic potential of characters. In the future, we will be moving away from a focus on primary weapons and toward a more strategic mix of characters and items.

Driven by this insight, we're embarking on a journey to introduce a fresh perspective over the medium to long term.

We will introduce new character concepts and balance their performance to ensure that each character has a unique playstyle and that each weapon is viable in different situations. We will continue to balance the game as needed to make sure that it is fair and fun for all players

Furthermore, we are not only balancing the existing weapons, but we are also incorporating future special weapon systems and enhanced traits to bring you a fresh new experience.

We value your enthusiasm and support as we move through this evolution, and we look forward to having you on board.

Sincerely,

A.V.A Global Operations & Dev Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global January Patch Note
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/b9249d62e256de53df2c89bcb1e4b2c142e3d70b.png

Mercenaries!

The Patch Notes for the January patch are finally here!

This patch contains various features, such as a new mode, content, and new skins that will be revealed gradually.

The skins that will be added immediately following this update are attractive too, but we will also open additional limited skins for Valentine's Day soon, so please stay tuned!

New Mode: Infection Mode

Map: Burning Temple, Dark Chamber, Dual Site, Prison Break

As the first update in 2023, we have added a new mode - Infection - to provide gamers with a more diverse gameplay experience.

[previewyoutube=wM0Je0WbJSc;full][/previewyoutube]

When you play Infection, you will encounter a whole new enemy that you have never met in A.V.A Global before.

This will provide an exciting gaming experience and a completely new gaming style.

"Infection" is a mode in which one of the players becomes an infected monster and tries to infect all the humans.

The "infected" will win if they successfully infect all the humans, and the humans will win if they defeat all the infected monsters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e754b5024c6ff666d01f923a4738d48b7f3babec.jpg

You will be able to enjoy "villain play" more in this A.V.A Global Infection mode since we have reinforced the creature features of the "infectious agents," allowing you to feel a little more superior when playing.

The infectious agents are classified into "Spore Host" and "Bubble Host."

The "Spore Host" carries one spore that can be used to attack and damage the enemy, and the "Bubble Host" carries 10 bubbles that can temporarily pause the enemy's movements.

The infectious agents have a little more HP, and although the genus has been slightly enhanced, there are no additional advantages.

Spore damage deducts 3 HP per second and lasts over 10 seconds to deduct 30 HP in total.

However, you can only have one spoiler, so try to use it effectively as your final weapon; otherwise, you will fall into a more challenging situation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/05334c4fb31547c2b5ae566b33a44ed1ba4ad059.jpg

In "Infection," the screen has been darkened to allow users to become more immersed in the gameplay.

Due to the darkened vision, the players will be able to feel the tension, and the infectious agent will be unable to find them easily.

Since the repeated gameplay on a fixed map can be tedious, we added cabinet objects to create more hiding space for humans.

If humans hide in the cabinets, each infectious agent will have to spend more time looking for the hiding humans; this adds to the thrills of the game by allowing the humans to overcome their fear and survive until the end of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7fc131c96cc5780a23bb48d4165c8c357493d3a0.jpg

As a reward for this new mode, a "Cursed Box" will be added, which you can receive along with the Premium Box & AVA Box.

The method of receiving the rewards is the same as in the Demolition.

The process for receiving rewards is the same as it is in the standard Demolition mode.

There is also a special item reward that can only be obtained in the “Cursed Box” of “Infection,” so please participate.

New Mode Rewards: Cursed Box, Premium Box, A.V.A Box obtainable

Red Slasher

New Content: Skin Combination

The "Skin Combination" system is a feature we are introducing to you for the first time; it is A.V.A Global's new trial and a brand-new game system you have not seen before.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fb7f01645477be9964249a5f0799a03adf6d3f84.png

This fascinating content will broaden your in-game play experiences.

Since the Skin Combination system is being introduced for the first time, we hope many users will try it out. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0c794804c91c1f0fa45ef1e7f4104e68e99e6c1a.png

We will continue to improve the system’s completeness through continuous patches in the future.

Skin Combination is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Exclusive Skin Combination Skins:

Bahamut Blue Valkyrie
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/73452ed5045ab8fce0453dfe4095175439048973.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1a08d5e22c597f67ce0553f3c051c235885db9d0.png

From Skin Combination, general Unique tier skins cannot be obtained.

However, there are exclusive Unique skins that can only be obtained through Skin Combination.
Skin Combination Jackpot Skins: Bahamut Blue Valkyrie, MA-47 Mammon, SR-F2 Gold Horse

The Exclusive Unique Skins will be added for the first time after the patch, and we have prepared one skin for each weapon class.

The list will expand through future patches, so please stay tuned!

Demolition - Map Changes

Staccato Open & Showdown Close
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f518f4d7ea9c20acabb2370f8bce6cea115a6843.jpg

Game System Updates
The following significant change this patch is bringing is the opening of the "South American" Server.
We plan to open a new server in this patch to improve the gameplay environment for South American users.
Through this enhancement, A.V.A Global will be accessible to a broader range of users, resulting in a more stable and enjoyable gaming environment.

Balance Update

First, Armour Piercing will be altered for M1903, X24, and Silver Arrow, and the ATK and Range of M1903 will be adjusted in accordance with the balance work.

Silver Arrow and X24's close-range One-Shot Kill chances will be increased to make the game more user-friendly.

While preserving the unique elements of A.V.A Global, we'll keep giving users additional opportunities to enjoy using a variety of weapons and providing realistic and varied gameplay experiences.

Ultimately, this Balance Patch aims to provide more engaging shooting play experiences by maximizing the diversity of weapon choices and making the game more enjoyable.

notes.title: [PREVIEW] December Patch Note
notes.notes:
Mercenaries! 

After careful consideration, the December update will bring you exciting content!
*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change

New Mode: Infinity Domination
Map: Crash Point
In particular, in the upcoming December update, we plan to release a PVE & PVP hybrid mode, known as "Infinite Domination" after the December update.
[previewyoutube=SySlBmKRXIQ;full][/previewyoutube]

In Infinite Domination, mercenaries have to capture and occupy a site to win the round. Your team engineers fix the computers which fill the site occupancy.

notes.title: What to expect in the December Update
notes.notes:
Mercenaries!

Before the December Update begins, we would like to welcome you to the last skin update of the year.

In this update, we have a series of Bloody Bark skins, mysterious Roswell skins, and many others!
The various skins are to be released in Season 2. These skins will be obtainable through a new mode, and the in-game shop!

notes.title: A.V.A Global System Changes: ARENA, Capsule
notes.notes:
Mercenaries!

To improve AVA Global, we have been working diligently to bring you new and exciting content. We have also improved the Arena system! 

We hope to continue to bring you a fun gameplay experience. 

This update will make changes based on community feedback. 

1. ARENA Mode Requirement 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e38d3561dde69f8ab3651423c56f165c9066dd93.jpg
Previously, we have already announced new game modes in the 2022 timeline. We have added: Arena, Escape, and Sr. Annihilation game modes to bring you excitement! After the update, we have received a lot of suggestions regarding the Arena Mode. 

Since the start of Arena Mode season 1, we have been listening to community suggestions. So, we have taken action by increasing the requirement for this wonderful game mode. The new requirement is Staff Sargent 1 (Level 11). This requirement will take effect after the update. 

The recent anti-cheat improvements have made significant improvements to community safety. 
We have made better ways to deal with those who violate the Code of Conduct by tampering with our community's beloved game: AVA Global.
 We have banned many users from playing for conducting unauthorized activities. 
Please check the full announcement in the link:


2. New Items!
To bring all mercenaries with skins they enjoy, we have added new skinned items to use on all your favorite game modes and maps!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ebf2195210a82954b6c0f913c05d23f161bffff3.jpg
Additionally, we have reduced the requirement to obtain capsule items. This means there is no level requirement. Now, new mercenaries can obtain beautiful skinned items to enjoy! 

Further, we are aware that mercenaries really care about gunplay. We will continue to improve and balance various aspects of it. We hope all mercenaries understand that this may take a couple of updates to achieve. We will continue to listen and honor your suggestions and feedback!

See you all in-game! 

Thank you all for your support!

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: AVA Global Release - August 25th!
notes.notes:
"A.V.A Global" is an online  FPS game that features online team-play and features a variety of actions using a unique combat system as well as strategic game-play that only "A.V.A Global" can offer.

Brand New Anti-Cheat - Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC):
Whether you are a beginner or an experienced mercenary, we will create a fair and balanced environment for all players with the new Easy Anti-Cheat. 

Removal of Pay2Win:
We understand everyone wants an equitable gameplay experience, so we have taken bold steps to remove Pay2Win. We want all players to enjoy AVA Global for many years to come!

We wanted to give AVA a fresh and modern look. Our team has revised and improved the game. We focused on creating a clean and organized design because we hope to bring you a smooth experience.

notes.title: Announcement regarding A.V.A release date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/4d74fb27c7c85a4961630368f408f8c2a6ba7269.jpg

To Our Dedicated and Patient Community,

We would like to share an important update from our event regarding the game launch. We have considered feedback from players within the community and we have made the difficult decision to delay the launch of the game to better prepare the build for the global market.

The game currently is a bit old and necessary changes need to be made in order to fit within the global standards. This includes, but is not limited to; balancing, bug fixes, and stability.

During the internal testing of the game, we’ve found stability and balance concerns that cannot be ignored. We have decided that we need to make the necessary changes to fit the global standards for a top-tier online shooter. We apologize for this unwelcome news, just as we hope to deliver an enjoyable game for everyone. 

We understand that this news is devastating to the many of you who have been waiting so long for AVA’s return to Steam, but we hope that you can understand why this decision was made. We want to ensure that the version of AVA we deliver is as good as can be, so that the game can last for a long time into the future. 

We apologize for the inconvenience this news may cause, and look forward to working with everyone to make the return of AVA as glorious as possible.

Thank you all for your enduring support and ceaseless understanding.

Sincerely,
Your A.V.A Team
